# Clone

Makes a deep copy of a value.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Clone(value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | any | The value to copy. Any value, null included. An array or an object is copied with every array and object inside it, so changing the copy never changes the original. A value that holds itself, is nested too deeply, or whose copy would pass the host's maximum value size is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Any. A copy equal to value. An array or an object that appears more than once inside value is copied once for each place it appears, so the copy shares no container with value or within itself. Null when value is null; never null otherwise.

## Example

`copy = Clone(data)` followed by `copy.name = "x"` leaves `data.name` unchanged.
